newIntro: Describe what you need and when. The provider receives your request on WHY ME and can accept, discuss details in chat, or send a quote.
titleHint: E.g. Fix leaking kitchen sink, or sew two ankara outfits.
titleRequired: Enter a short summary (at least 3 characters).
locationHint: Choose the LGA or area in Delta State where you need the service.
descriptionHint: Explain what needs to be done, the size of the job, and any materials needed. No phone numbers or links: talk in WHY ME chat.
preferredDateInvalid: Choose today or a future date.
budgetHint: Give the provider an idea of what you expect to spend. You can agree the final quote later.
budgetInvalid: Enter whole amounts of ₦0 or more (maximum must be at least the minimum).
photosHint: Add up to {{max}} photos to show what needs doing or the space.
safetyNote: Keep all messages, quotes and agreements on WHY ME. Do not include phone numbers, bank details, emails or links.
targetMissing: Choose a service or provider page first to request a service.
requestsIntro: Services you requested from providers, and requests customers sent to you.
emptyRequested: No service requests yet. Use "Request this service" on a service listing or provider page to get started.
emptyReceived: No service requests received yet. When a customer requests your service, it appears here.
loadFailed: Couldn't load service requests. Check your connection.
requestLoadFailed: Couldn't load this service request. Check your connection.
sendQuoteTitle: Set your real price for this job
sendQuoteHint: Enter the exact amount you will accept this job for and what is included. Once the customer accepts your price, it becomes the agreed amount for the job.
quoteAmountInvalid: Enter an amount of at least ₦1.
quoteScopeLabel: What is included in this price?
quoteScopeHint: Explain the work, materials or terms covered by this price. No phone numbers, bank details or links.
quoteScopeRequired: Explain what is included (at least 5 characters).
customerQuoteWaiting: {{provider}} offered to do this job for {{amount}}. Accept this quote to lock in the agreed price, or ask for a revision.
customerQuoteAccepted: Agreed amount: {{amount}} (Quote v{{version}}). This is the agreed price for the job.
providerQuoteWaiting: You quoted {{amount}} (Quote v{{version}}). Waiting for {{customer}} to accept your price before you start work.
providerQuoteRejected: {{customer}} asked for a different price on Quote v{{version}} ({{amount}}). Send a revised quote below.
providerQuoteAccepted: {{customer}} accepted your quote of {{amount}} (Quote v{{version}}). You can now start the work.
declineQuoteHint: Tell the provider what price or scope works for you (for example, ₦300,000) so they can send a revised quote.
listSafety: Keep service updates, quotes and conversations on WHY ME. Open a request to respond or follow its progress.
heldBanner: Waiting for a WHY ME moderator to check this request. Only you can see it for now.
rejectedBanner: WHY ME couldn't deliver this request: {{reason}}
customerSubmittedBanner: Your request has been sent to {{provider}}. You can also message them in chat while you wait.
customerAcceptedBanner: {{provider}} accepted your request. Agree the schedule and details in WHY ME chat.
customerInProgressBanner: {{provider}} has started work on your request.
customerCompletionSubmittedBanner: {{provider}} marked this work as complete. Please check the work and confirm below once you are satisfied.
customerCompletedBanner: You confirmed the work is complete. Thank you for using WHY ME!
providerSubmittedBanner: {{customer}} requested your service. Accept if you can take it on, or message them in chat to ask questions.
providerAcceptedBanner: You accepted this request. When you begin the job, mark it as started below.
providerInProgressBanner: This job is in progress. When you finish the work, mark it as complete so the customer can confirm.
providerCompletionSubmittedBanner: Waiting for {{customer}} to confirm the work is complete.
acceptHint: Accept if you are available to take on this request. You can discuss the exact scope and timing in chat.
declineHint: Let the customer know why you can't take this on (they will see this).
noteHint: E.g. what was done or what to check. No phone numbers or links.
confirmHint: Confirm only when the provider has finished the work and you are satisfied.
confirmQuestion: Confirm that {{provider}} has completed this work?
changedMeanwhile: This request changed meanwhile. Here is the latest.
protectedPaymentUnpaidBody: Pay the agreed {{amount}} through WHY ME. We hold your money safely until {{provider}} completes the job and you confirm.
paymentHeldBody: {{amount}} is paid and held by WHY ME. It will only be released to {{provider}} after you confirm the work is complete.
paymentHeldProviderBody: {{customer}} has paid {{amount}} into WHY ME protection. WHY ME holds it and releases it to you once the customer confirms the work is complete.
paymentReleaseEligibleBody: Work confirmed complete. {{amount}} is ready for WHY ME to release to the provider.
paymentReleasedBody: {{amount}} has been released to the provider.
